objectives.statement: Recognize and form bli-passives for present, simple past, and present perfect events.
Use s-passive naturally in present, infinitive, and modal constructions.
Choose between bli-passive and s-passive according to tense, style, and meaning.
Add an av-agent only when useful and avoid outdated simple past s-passives.

notes: Must contrast bli-passive and s-passive in modern Bokmål. Include present/infinitive s-passive, modal + s-passive, past/perfect bli-passive, av-agent only when relevant, and warn against preterite s-passive such as sendtes.
